voice.title: Conversation names
voice.description: Choose a language and resource to edit aliases. “—” saves only the default subject. ⚠ marks an unavailable reference: clear its aliases or choose a current subject. The default is used only for “me” when assigned to the tracker.

alias.description: Resource: {resource}. Enter one alias per line (up to 30, each 100 characters). Leave empty to remove aliases for this language. Repeat configuration for other resources. Shared aliases require clarification.

error.invalid_reference: Choose a current resource or clear unavailable aliases.
